ارتهنوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَهَنُوا (irtahanū) /ir.ta.ha.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اُرْتُهِنُوا (urtuhinū) /ur.tu.hi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# اِرْتَهِنُوا (irtahinū) /ir.ta.hi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
